title: Runner multi-repo phase 3: --target-repo flag and intake field plumbing
problem: After phases 1 and 2 land, the runner has the mechanical capability to operate on a non-apiary target repo (target-aware worktree creation, apiary-rooted artifact storage, PYTHONPATH-based stage loading), but no surface to actually request that. There is no CLI flag to point a runner pass at a target repo, no intake-schema field to declare a per-ticket target, and no config default for the common case. Without this ticket the multi-repo capability is unreachable from the operator's side.
description: Add a `--target-repo <path>` CLI flag to `python -m runner.run` (both interactive and detached modes). Add an optional `target_repo` field to the intake schema (validated by validate_intake.py — non-empty string if present, must resolve to an existing directory containing a .git/ entry). Add a `runner.target_repo` default to runner/config.json. Resolution precedence (highest first): CLI flag, intake field, config default, fallback = apiary REPO_ROOT (preserves current behavior when nothing is set). Wire the resolved target through run_detached and the interactive main into Phase 1's git_worktree_create API and run_stage's cwd argument. Update run_history entries to record which target_repo a run targeted, so a single apiary checkout's history captures runs across multiple target repos coherently. Document the flag in runner/CLAUDE.md and any operator-facing docs that describe the runner CLI.
scope: runner/run.py (CLI flag, target resolution, plumbing into run_detached and interactive main), runner/validate_intake.py (target_repo field), runner/config.json (target_repo default — typically null), runner/run_history.py (target_repo column in history entries), runner/CLAUDE.md and any other docs describing the runner CLI. New tests in runner/test_target_repo.py (precedence resolution) and runner/test_run_detached.py (end-to-end target-repo flag). Acceptance: a runner pass with --target-repo pointing at a separate scratch git repo creates the worktree inside that scratch repo, branches from its master, runs stages with cwd=<scratch worktree>, writes all runner artifacts under apiary/runner/<dir>/, and commits the work into the scratch repo's runner/<slug>-<uuid> branch. OUT OF SCOPE: the auto_plan prompt-rule strip (phase 4), any auto-bootstrap of the target repo (e.g. setting up its own .apiary/ or claude-config), any cross-repo cost aggregation beyond the run_history target_repo column.
context: Part of the runner multi-repo rearchitecture epic agreed in session 27d1126d (2026-04-16). Phase 1 (in-session) lays the resolver + worktree foundation; phase 2 (separate ticket) makes stage subprocesses load from apiary regardless of cwd; this phase 3 ticket exposes the capability to operators. Depends on both phase 1 and phase 2 landing first. Phase 4 (separate ticket) handles the auto_plan prompt's apiary-specific rules and unlocks running against repos with different language/test conventions.
